records.eligibility_summary: The Equalization Grant (TEG) is awarded to freshmen who are not residents of Louisiana and meet the minimum eligibility requirement of a 3.0 Centenary GPA (recalculated based on core courses only, on a four point scale). The TEG is awarded to transfers whose core high school GPA was 3.0 or higher, are not residents of Louisiana, and are transferring in less than 32 credit hours. This award is $5,000/year.
